interface.name: zsingularity_snap_manager_v1
interface.description: Lets a desktop shell offer a layout picker when the pointer rests on the maximize button of a window or drags a window to the top edge of an output, and snap windows to arbitrary zones of the work area. Nothing is shown until a client enables the picker.

request.name: set_enabled

description.summary: enable or disable the picker triggers

request.description: While no bound client has the picker enabled the compositor keeps its own edge snapping behaviour and sends no picker events.

request.name: set_picker_area
request.description: Reports the picker rectangle in output layout coordinates. While the cursor of a window drag is inside it the compositor does not snap the window itself and reports the release with a drop event. A zero width or height clears the area.

request.name: set_zone_preview
request.description: Shows or hides the compositor snapping overlay over a zone, in output layout coordinates, while a window is being dragged.

request.name: snap_to_zone

description.summary: snap a window to a zone

request.description: Snaps a toplevel to a zone of the work area of the output that contains the reference point. The zone is given in thousandths of the work area. The window stays snapped when the work area changes and returns to its previous size when it is dragged away.

request.name: button_enter

description.summary: pointer rests on a client drawn maximize button

request.description: For clients that draw their own window controls. Reports that the pointer entered the maximize button of a toplevel surface; the rectangle is in surface local coordinates. The compositor treats it like its own maximize button: after the usual delay, and only while the pointer is still over that surface, the enabled clients receive picker_show with the button source for that window. Nothing happens while no client has the picker enabled.

request.name: button_leave

description.summary: pointer left a client drawn maximize button

request.description: The pointer left the maximize button reported with button_enter, or the button was pressed. A pending picker is cancelled and a shown one receives picker_hide with the button source.

event.name: picker_show
event.description: The anchor is the maximize button for the button source and the cursor position for the drag source. The area is the work area of the output, all in output layout coordinates.

event.name: picker_motion
event.description: Cursor position in output layout coordinates while a drag picker is shown.

event.name: picker_hide
event.description: For the drag source the picker must go away. For the button source the pointer left the maximize button; the client may keep the picker while the pointer is over it.

event.name: picker_drop
event.description: The dragged window was released inside the picker area at the given cursor position. The compositor did not snap it.
